title: Stack of British Standard Test Sieves on a lab bench

One circular sieve lid with a black knob is visible on the bench to the left of the stack; the lid is not on the stack and appears cropped at the left edge of the bench area.
One rectangular metal tray is visible on the bench to the right of the stack; the tray is fully visible and sits on the same bench surface.

Several electrical cables and wall sockets are visible along the back wall above the benches.
No people are visible in the photographed scene.
